title: The Orchard of the Old Mill House
author: Jonah Crane
blurb: Ulyana Ashgrove, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
